防御.notes: The posture or the system: 防御能力/系统/工事 · 加强防御 · 防御性. 抵御 is the act of holding out against a thing — 抵御寒冷. Mnemo: 防 = 阝 (wall) + 方. 御 (imperial) = 彳 (step) + 卸 (unload), and 卸's left half is 午 (noon) + 止 (stop) — the lunch break. The emperor steps past while the guard unloads for lunch.

适用.sentence: 该优惠对特价商品不适用。
适用.pinyin: Gāi yōuhuì duì tèjià shāngpǐn bù shìyòng.
适用.english: This discount does not apply to sale items.
